title: Astro Jumpers
problem: A local bounce house rental business needed customers to see what's open and book without phone tag.
built: A fast, mobile-first website with live availability, online booking, and a simple admin page the owner runs from a phone.
imageAlt: Astro Jumpers home page with an astronaut bounce house logo and a Book Now button

title: Mill Housekeeping Log
problem: Dust and debris checks in industrial grain mills were tracked on paper, so missed areas were easy to overlook.
built: A mobile-first app that shows which areas are due or overdue, logs each inspection with a photo, and saves to the device so it keeps working where the signal is bad.
imageAlt: Mill Housekeeping Log app showing a list of inspection areas marked Due

title: Car Doctor
problem: Figuring out what's wrong with a car or truck usually means guessing, searching forums, or paying for a diagnosis before you even know where to look.
built: An installable phone app that diagnoses problems from plain-English symptoms and OBD-II trouble codes. Tap through what you notice and where, and get answers in plain English from a machine-learning model I trained myself that runs right on the phone, offline and free. It knows the common problems of nearly 200 vehicles, explains dashboard lights, finds a mechanic nearby, and adds maintenance reminders to the phone's calendar.
imageAlt: Three Car Doctor phone screens: tap-to-pick symptom tiles, a diagnosis with a gauge dial and a known-problem note, and a vehicle's known problems
